name: Qwen-Image 2.1 Doodle-In LoRA
description: Scribble an outline on a photo, name it, it appears

paragraphs: Demo for ML-Intern-lab/Qwen-Image-2.1-doodle-in-LoRA, an edit LoRA for Qwen-Image 2.1 trained by ML Intern on ML-Intern-lab/doodle-in-pairs: real Open Images photos as targets, the same photos with one object removed by LaMa and a magenta scribble drawn in its place as inputs.

Draw an outline in magenta on a photo, type what it is, and the model draws that object into the scribble. The prompt sent to the model is Turn the magenta scribble into {caption}. Strokes are redrawn at the training width (5 px at a 768 px short side) before inference, so the brush size does not matter.
Example photos are from Open Images V7 (CC BY 2.0), modified; credits are in the app. Qwen-Image 2.1 and both LoRAs are under the Qwen Research License (non-commercial research use). Built with Qwen.
features: Turbo stacks the Viggle 6-step LoRA (sigmas [1.0, 0.9375, 0.875, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25], no CFG). Quality uses the base 40-step schedule.
Defaults to checkpoint 500, which won the model card's checkpoint selection; 1000, 1500 and 2000 are available for comparison.
On the card's 160 held-out pairs, checkpoint 500 + turbo scored the best object hit rate of six configurations (67.5%, 4.7 s/edit on an A100).
A checkbox runs the base model with a plain instruction on the same seed, which is the evaluation's baseline.
